caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object resembling a horseshoe or an open oval loop with flattened ends. The object is oriented with the open ends facing downward and each end has a circular hole near its tip. The surface of the object is textured and appears rough, showing a mottled pattern of colors including shades of brown, reddish-brown, gray, and rust, indicative of aged or weathered metal. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color, creating a contrast that makes the object stand out clearly. The drawing includes a signature and date, written in small text below the object: "Paul Leambeach 1948."
title: Peak Halyard Band
